summary.text: Josh Jensen is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 134 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Greece town board member and communications professional, he was first elected to the Assembly in 2020 and is the ranking minority member of the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jensen began his career in public service with state Senator Joe Robach, serving as his director of communications and director of community affairs and public policy.

He later worked as a client strategy and relations supervisor for a Rochester-area public relations agency and as director of communications at a large Upstate New York nursing home, and he served as an adjunct professor of political science at Niagara University.
He graduated from Niagara University and Hilton High School.
Jensen represented the Town of Greece's 3rd Ward on the town board from 2018 to 2020.
He was elected to the Assembly on November 3, 2020, and represents the towns of Greece, Ogden and Parma and the villages of Hilton and Spencerport in Monroe County.

He is vice-chair of the Minority Joint Conference Committee and ranking minority member of the Health Committee, and also serves on the Children and Families; Corporations, Authorities and Commissions; Insurance; and Rules committees.
